title: Joja Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Joja Cap |image = Joja Cap.png |source = Desert Festival }} The '''Joja Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Joja Cap. ==Notes== * The Joja Cap outfit also includes a [[File:Shirt105.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 46,85,183). ==References== See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue".
